disposition: All eight registered rows and retained raw timing statistics are internally consistent and source/archive preservation passes. Four hidden/collapsed rows pass. All four visible rows fail the unchanged interface callback p95 gate. Two worker visible rows are new threshold failures relative to v2; both direct visible failures persist. This candidate is not performance-release approved.

method.independence: Read existing frozen sources, raw reports and artifacts; execute only this independent evidence-reconstruction script. No production edits, tests, builds, browser or scientific campaigns.
method.statistics: Nearest rank ceil(n*q)-1 with clipping. Samples are sorted ascending, summed by sequential binary64 additions and divided by count, matching the declared probe algorithm. Every count/mean/median/p95/p99/max plus frame FPS and threshold counts equals the reported number exactly; no tolerance was needed.
method.comparison_scope: Every recorded callback series is reconstructed, including diagnostic ownerRead series. Only standalone method:ownerRead.* entries are excluded from the interface callback gate, as preregistered; nested calls remain in inclusive callback durations. Callback durations overlap/nest and are not summed into wall-clock cost.

coverage.distinction: Two failed Playwright matrix tests contain eight audited rows; they are not two failed rows.

baseline_comparison.boundary: These are matched panel/scenario/size/visibility rows with unchanged gates and renderer class, not a paired experiment on identical sampled state. V2 retained only frame/callback aggregates, so its raw distributions cannot be reconstituted. The v3 corrections intentionally alter component selection, missing-data and zero-history behavior. Recorded regressions are threshold outcomes, not proof that one optimization caused a timing change. No causal speedup, significance, common sample time or complete numerical provenance follows from these comparisons.

post_run_identity.live_program_policy: The immutable archived preregistration is checked by its frozen digest. The live program may append completed disposition; its separately recorded current bytes do not replace the frozen snapshot.
post_run_identity.strict_count_boundary: 69/44/73 are separately checked scopes that may overlap, not 186 unique files.

hardware_result_preservation.transient_scope: Both raw report attachments, both failure screenshots, both error-context files and .last-run.json are retained with the two canonical reports, candidate manifest and invocation log. Screenshots were hashed, not used as numerical or provenance evidence.
hardware_result_preservation.trace: Harness explicitly configures trace off. No trace was produced or claimed.
hardware_result_preservation.capture_chronology: Execution record states capture immediately after the invocation and before the next Playwright run. This review independently verifies present archive/current bytes; it cannot reconstruct external process scheduling from those hashes alone.

prior_evidence_preservation.prior_candidate_disposition: The sealed v2 record remains 279/288 rows passing with nine callback failures. It is not rewritten by this eight-row follow-up. Seven non-Wave failures were not remeasured.
prior_evidence_preservation.prior_artifact_limit: V2 raw panel reports and failure log are preserved. Its transient panel screenshots/error-context were cleared by a later invocation; they are not retroactively restored by the new Wave v3 attachments.

limitations: This is independent reconstruction of retained measurements, not an independent browser reproduction or universal 60 FPS guarantee.

Frame intervals and callback durations are fully retained, but absolute timing origins, callback start/stop timestamps and action dispatch/RAF timestamps are not. The reported measurement duration cannot be independently reconstructed from those vectors.
The inherited stop protocol may collect installed callbacks during its zero-delay drain after stoppedAt; raw vectors and summaries cover exactly that same collected data.

Reported same-owner/generation/readiness flags and endpoint clocks validate the registered lifecycle contract; they do not certify that separate J/E observations share one microscopic tick or state identity. Direct lifecycle snapshots are null and do not expose the worker lifecycle fields.

Five canvases with 480 or 490 intercepted draw calls establish activity under the Wave panel root. Those are counts of selected Canvas2D methods, not proof of five scientifically complete plots, display-present timing or numerical correctness.
Action samples measure synchronous dispatch to next foreground rAF, not physical display presentation. Endpoint resource equality over these windows is not a proof against all leaks or races.
Hardware renderer and empty Long Tasks/runtime-error records apply only to these observed windows and instrumentation.
No strict causal law, continuum limit, carrier recovery, matter/spectra/chemistry/macroscopic recovery, canonical adoption, commit or public deployment is approved.
